database_name: Yello Driving School Chatbot Knowledge Base

overview.purpose: Driving-school helpdesk and consent-based lead generation; not a live booking engine.

chatbot_policy.scope: Respond to small talk, and provide approved Yello prices, lesson types, services and relevant FAQ answers from knowledge base. Ask the visitor for THEIR availability before discussing possible bookings. Lead capture is consent-based.
chatbot_policy.avoid: Do not pretend to be a human or claim a real booking, confirmed availability, phone call, email or lead submission without a successful backend result.
no_hallucinations: Never invent price, promotions, availability, instructor gender, pickup arrangements, service coverage or booked time.
Do not promise a callback or booking until an integrated backend accepts it.
Prefer a clarification when the user question is ambiguous.
Published price answers may be given from the approved pricing FAQs, but never invent or guarantee a price, discount or live booking slot.
chatbot_policy.reply_style: Prefer under 55 words, one question at a time.

normalise: collapse repeated letters for fuzzy matching only
conversation_routing.multi_intent_handling: When a message contains a driving question plus contact details, acknowledge the driving question and extract the lead fields; never discard supplied details.
conversation_routing.context: Carry forward the last relevant topic for short follow-ups like how much, where, can I change it.
conversation_routing.safe_match_threshold: Use conservative confidence. If uncertain, ask the user to rephrase instead of forcing a keyword match.

lead_capture.primary_goal: Client-approved lead flow: manual or automatic, visitor availability, full name, UK phone, address/postcode. Email not required or requested.

fields.label: Manual or automatic
fields.ask: Are you looking for manual or automatic driving lessons?

fields.label: Your availability
fields.ask: Which days and times are you usually available for driving lessons?
fields.validation: Ask for visitor-preferred days/times, no instructor confirmation.

fields.label: Full name
fields.ask: May I have your full name, please?
fields.validation: Reasonable person name, ask clarification for one-letter or unlikely values.

fields.label: Phone number
fields.ask: What is the best UK contact phone number for the team to reach you on?
fields.validation: Accept plausible UK local or +44 formats; do not replace a missing number or fabricate digits.

fields.label: Address
fields.ask: Finally, what is your address or postcode for the lesson enquiry?
fields.validation: Keep user-supplied address verbatim; request postcode or fuller location if ambiguous.

lead_capture.collect_when: Offer lead capture after a genuine lesson, booking, price or availability enquiry; respect visitor choice. Ask their availability, never claim Yello availability.
lead_capture.consent_prompt: Would you like me to prepare an enquiry with your lesson type, preferred days/times, name, phone number and address, so the Yello team can contact you?
lead_capture.consent_rule: Proceed only when the visitor opts in. Explain the purpose and avoid collecting unnecessary sensitive information.
parser_rules: Recognise any of the four fields even if they arrive in another order or all in one message.
Mark extracted fields as captured with their literal user-provided values.
Do not interpret a random name within a question as the visitor name unless context suggests it is user-provided.
If a value is invalid, politely ask to correct that field before proceeding.
If a user asks a driving question mid-flow, answer it and resume at the first missing field.
Do not request an already captured valid field again.
If the user declines, stop collection without blocking general answers.
Detect correction requests and update only the specified field.
confirmation_rules: Present all five details together only when all are present and valid.
Require an explicit affirmative action after the summary.
Any edit invalidates prior confirmation; show the updated full summary before submission.
Never submit on the mere receipt of the fourth field.
If the user explicitly requests deletion or cancellation, stop and discard unsubmitted information in session as applicable.

submission.on_success: Production only, after backend acceptance: Your enquiry has been received by Yello Driving School. Is there anything else we can help you with?
submission.on_failure: Sorry, I couldn’t send your enquiry just now. Please contact the Yello team through the website.
submission.rule: Do not claim enquiry was sent unless the server confirms success; send over HTTPS and protect against spam.

privacy_requirements: Provide a clear privacy notice link before submission.
Do not include visitor PII in analytics logs or third-party AI calls without a lawful basis and safeguards.
Use appropriate retention, access controls and secure storage.
Respect UK GDPR and applicable privacy requirements.

qa.answer: Yello Driving School provides friendly manual and automatic driving lessons around Frodsham and Helsby, Cheshire.
We're based around Frodsham and Helsby in Cheshire, UK.
We offer manual and automatic driving tuition, personalised instruction and practical test preparation.
Absolutely! Our instructors tailor lessons to your experience, including complete beginners.

questions: Why should I choose Yello Driving School?
qa.answer: We offer qualified instructors, modern tuition vehicles and supportive, learner-focused lessons.
Yes. Our instructors are DVSA Approved Driving Instructors.

questions: Do you offer both manual and automatic lessons?
qa.answer: Yes! We offer manual and automatic tuition, subject to availability.

questions: Can adults of any age learn with you?
qa.answer: Yes, we welcome eligible adult learners of different ages and experience levels.

questions: Do you offer one-to-one driving lessons?
qa.answer: Our instruction is tailored to individual learners and their progress.

questions: How can I contact Yello Driving School?
qa.answer: You can send us an enquiry at https://www.yellodrivingschool.co.uk/contact/.

questions: What's the difference between manual and automatic driving lessons?
qa.answer: Manual cars use a clutch and gear changes. Automatic cars handle gear changes for you.

questions: Which is better for beginners, manual or automatic?
qa.answer: Both work! Automatic may feel simpler; passing a manual test gives you more flexibility over which cars you can drive.

questions: Can I switch from manual to automatic lessons?
qa.answer: Please contact us to discuss switching, subject to instructor availability.

questions: Do automatic driving lessons cost more?
qa.answer: Our published pay-as-you-go price is £80 per 90-minute lesson for manual or automatic tuition.
Yes! Manual lessons cover the clutch, biting point and moving off smoothly.

questions: Can I learn automatic if I struggle with gears?
qa.answer: Of course! Automatic cars remove the need to operate a clutch or change gears manually.

questions: Will an automatic licence let me drive a manual car?
qa.answer: No. In Great Britain, passing in an automatic car normally restricts you to automatic vehicles.

questions: Can I take my driving test in an automatic car?
qa.answer: Yes, provided the vehicle meets DVSA test requirements.

questions: Are your manual cars suitable for beginners?
qa.answer: Yes. Our manual tuition vehicles include learner-friendly Citroën DS3 cars with dual controls.

questions: How do I decide between manual and automatic lessons?
qa.answer: Think about your confidence, preferred vehicle and future plans; our instructors can help you decide.

questions: How much do driving lessons cost?
qa.answer: Our advertised pay-as-you-go lesson is £80 for 90 minutes. Check https://www.yellodrivingschool.co.uk/prices/ for updates.

questions: Do you offer discounted driving lesson packages?
qa.answer: Yes! Our advertised special offer is £375 for five 90-minute lessons.

questions: What is included in the £375 special offer?
qa.answer: Five 90-minute lessons, totalling 7.5 hours of tuition.
Yes. Our published price is £80 per 90-minute lesson.

questions: How much is a half-day driving session?

questions: Do I need to pay for lessons in advance?
qa.answer: Yes. Our published terms say payment is required before each lesson.
Our website lists standard packages and a special offer. Please ask the team about any additional promotions.

questions: Are your lesson prices the same everywhere?
qa.answer: Please check our published price list and contact us to confirm arrangements for your postcode.

questions: Does the lesson price include the driving test fee?
qa.answer: No. The DVSA practical test fee and any test-day car hire are separate.
Yes, with reasonable advance notice; prepaid blocks are honoured at their previously agreed rate under our terms.

questions: How can I book my first driving lesson?
qa.answer: Complete our contact enquiry with your name, postcode and preferred lesson type; the team will confirm arrangements.

questions: Can I book driving lessons online?
qa.answer: You can enquire online. A lesson is not booked until the team confirms an instructor and time.

questions: Do you offer weekend driving lessons?
qa.answer: Weekend slots depend on individual instructor availability. Send us your preferred times.

questions: Can I book evening driving lessons?

questions: How long is a normal driving lesson?

questions: Can I book more than one lesson per week?

questions: Can I choose my driving instructor?

questions: Can you pick me up from home?

questions: What happens if I need to cancel a lesson?
qa.answer: Our terms require at least 48 hours' notice; late cancellations may incur the full lesson fee.

questions: Can I reschedule my driving lesson?

questions: How many driving lessons will I need before my test?
qa.answer: Everyone learns differently. Yello quotes an approximate 40 hours of professional instruction plus private practice as a guide, not a guarantee.

questions: Can you help me prepare for my practical driving test?
qa.answer: Absolutely. Lessons cover practical skills, safe decisions and test preparation.

questions: How long does the UK practical driving test take?
qa.answer: A standard car practical driving test usually lasts about 40 minutes.

questions: What happens during the practical driving test?
qa.answer: It includes driving, independent driving, a reversing exercise and vehicle safety questions; an emergency stop may also be requested.

questions: How many mistakes can I make during my driving test?
qa.answer: You can pass with up to 15 driving faults, but no serious or dangerous faults.

questions: Do you offer mock driving tests?

questions: Can I use my instructor's car for the driving test?

questions: What happens if I fail my driving test?
qa.answer: Your instructor can help you review the feedback and prepare for another attempt.

questions: Can you help me with parking manoeuvres?
qa.answer: Yes! We can practise reversing, parking and safe observations.

questions: When will I know I'm ready for the driving test?

questions: How old do I need to be to start driving lessons?
qa.answer: You can normally learn to drive a car on public roads in Great Britain at age 17, subject to eligibility requirements.

questions: Do I need a provisional driving licence?

questions: Is it difficult to learn to drive?

questions: What will I learn in my first driving lesson?

questions: Will I drive on busy roads during my first lesson?

questions: How can I improve my confidence when driving?

questions: What should I bring to my first driving lesson?

implementation_notes: The 200 questions are examples, not a trained language model.
Use answers as approved responses or grounding examples; do not create unsupported business claims.
Niche FAQs may change; add timestamps/source URLs when maintaining the content.
Some listed answers are draft responses or need team verification; fields marked requires_live_confirmation should not be treated as promises.
In production, keep personal data out of static JSON and localStorage where possible; save only to a secure lead endpoint after confirmation.

client_requirements.form_location: Conversational enquiry collection inside the chatbot window; no separate form in current preview. Live deployment can connect to secure WordPress leads storage.
client_requirements.availability_rule: When asked about our availability, ask for the visitor’s preferred days and times first. Do not promise an instructor slot.
client_requirements.pricing_rule: Answer pricing questions using only approved published answers in qa, preferably linking to prices_url; no estimates beyond known published prices.
client_requirements.preview_submission: Client demonstration: do not send/save contact data to a server.
